title: 第三章 任务失败变太监？
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林夕将戒指带到手上以后，还没来得及欣赏。...

系统的提示音再次响起

“系统检测到宿主，已经到达一级，任务系统即将开启。”

“任务系统开启中”

“任务系统开启成功”

“任务一：杀死10只普通丧尸”

“任务完成奖励100经验值白色抽奖卷一张”

“任务失败惩罚变太监”

“什么？变太监？”林夕小声的惊呼道

“这是什么惩罚啊！还有为什么感觉你再笑啊！”

林夕心里对着系统狂喊道

“任务时间24小时”

“任务开始”

系统并没有理会林夕的感叹

直接就是让林夕开始执行任务

林夕脸黑的坐在床上

不一会，便站了起来，脸上的表情也由震惊慢慢恢复到了平静的状态

林夕心里想着：“可能系统是为了防止我偷懒，不努力然后死掉？它一个系统它在害怕什么。”

林夕想了想没有想明白，索性就不再去想。

而是悄悄的

只见窗外的天空暗淡无光，雾蒙蒙的一片，成群结队的丧尸漫无目的的在校园里到处游荡

林夕还看见了往日认识的几名同学，林夕叹了一口气，慢慢的合上了窗帘

林夕又走到门边，轻轻的将门前的各种物体移开

缓缓地将门缝第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

After Lin Xi took the ring to her hand, she didn't have time to appreciate it....

The system beep sounds again

"The system has detected the host and has reached level one. The mission system is about to start."

"The mission system is opening"

"Task system started successfully"

"Task 1: Kill 10 ordinary zombies"

"The mission completion reward is 100 experience points and a white lottery ticket"

"Punishment for mission failure is to become a eunuch"

"What? Become a eunuch?" Lin Xi exclaimed in a low voice.

"What kind of punishment is this! And why do I feel like you are laughing again!"

Lin Xi yelled at the system in her heart

"Task time is 24 hours"

"Mission begins"

The system ignored Lin Xi’s sigh.

Just let Lin Xi start the task

Lin Xi sat on the bed with a dark face

After a while, he stood up, and the expression on his face slowly returned from shock to a calm state.

Lin Xi thought to herself: "Maybe the system is trying to prevent me from being lazy, not working hard and dying? It's a system. What is it afraid of?"

Lin Xi thought for a while but didn't understand it, so she simply stopped thinking about it.

But quietly

The sky outside the window was dim and foggy, and groups of zombies were wandering aimlessly around the campus.

Lin Xi also saw several classmates she knew in the past. Lin Xi sighed and slowly closed the curtains.

Lin Xi walked to the door again and gently moved various objects in front of the door.
